Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE ultra high fidelity desktop application interface, edge-to-edge at landscape approximately 1440 x 960, front-on orthographic and legible. This is the actual interface surface for Pointer, a Windows cursor customization utility, not a marketing poster, not a computer or browser mockup.
Committed aesthetic: an exceptional Apple system software / Liquid Glass level of finish, translated to a real Windows application. Pearl #F6F6F8 canvas, opaque white content, graphite #25262B dark preview, ink #202126, restrained #0064D8 selected controls. Delicate translucent neutral navigation with precise luminous edges and soft downward shadows, concentric corner geometry, beautifully balanced whitespace, crisp thin icon family, refined Chinese system typography. These are flat accurate cursor specimens with NO halo and NO shadow from the arrow. Use readable actual Chinese labels, no invented claims.
